oxhead.definition:
n. Literally, the head of an ox (emblem of cuckoldom); hence,
   a dolt; a blockhead.

oxheart.definition:
n any of several cultivated sweet cherries having sweet juicy heart-shaped fruits
n large heart-shaped sweet cherry with soft flesh
oxheart.translation: n. 牛心形樱桃, 鸡心大樱桃

oxhide.definition:
n. The skin of an ox, or leather made from it.
n. A measure of land. See 3d Hide.

oxhides.definition:
-s form of oxhide
n. The skin of an ox, or leather made from it.
n. A measure of land. See 3d Hide.
oxhides.translation: (oxhide 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 牛皮
